messages:
elaine: Need a tiny paste-ready runbook for a presales POC (streaming + funccalls + structured JSON). Client wants hosted only and a rough cost hint for ~40 rps @ ~1k tokens.
omar: Short checklist: 1) request ephemeral token from presales endpoint; 2) init SDK with credentialProvider; 3) open WS using subprotocol rwd-stream-v1; 4) send meta frame with schema_id and strict flag; 5) handle toolcall -> send tool_response.
tara: Streaming knobs: max_inflight=6, heartbeat=20s, exponential backoff on 429s. For bursts use short batch REST.
elainE: haha small typo above :grimacing: but great. Can you paste a one-paragraph runbook + curl?
omar: Pasteable runbook: "Call POST https://presales.redwood.ai/v1/ephemeral with your account id to get an ephemeral token. Use that token with the Redwood SDK credentialProvider to open a WebSocket to wss://stream.redwood.ai/v1?model=<model> with subprotocol `rwd-stream-v1`, send a `meta` frame with `schema_id` (and `strict:true` for schema validation), then stream inputs. Handle `toolcall` messages by replying with `tool_response` frames. For sustained high throughput request a short Dedicated trial. Example curl: `curl -X POST https://presales.redwood.ai/v1/ephemeral -H 'Authorization: Bearer PRESALES_KEY' -d '{"account":"acme-health"}'`." 
dev-bot: demo-runbook v1 pushed to presales-bucket :white_check_mark:
tara: Pricing hint: 40 rps * ~1k tokens ~= 3.5B tokens/day if 24/7; for an 8h/day POC it's ~1.2B. Recommend a 1-2 hour representative run to estimate costs.
elaine: Thanks, sending to customer now.
